mainEntity.name: What are these custom training and fight shorts designed for?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are an OEM/ODM reference for gym training, striking workouts and fightwear collections. Confirm fit and movement on a sample; for BJJ/MMA grappling or competition, review drawcord security, pockets, hardware and event rules separately.

The supplied brief specifies 92% polyester / 8% spandex stretch woven. Exact GSM and measurable stretch, drying, tear and water-resistance properties are not supplied and require a selected material record or test.

mainEntity.name: Is this a full two-in-one compression liner?

acceptedAnswer.text: The images show printed mesh at the inside hem. They do not establish a full fitted compression liner. Confirm the inner panel coverage, lining construction and any required two-in-one version during sampling.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize the blue-purple geometric print and logos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Discuss your own colors, geometric artwork, vertical wordmark, emblem, labels and packaging. Confirm print/transfer method, artwork permissions, color matching and wash performance on the approved sample.

mainEntity.name: What sizes and quantities should I send?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send waist, hip, rise, outseam, inseam, leg opening and slit-height requirements, followed by quantities per size and colorway. Confirm actual measurements and tolerances rather than relying on a generic 5–7 inch range.

mainEntity.name: Are the shorts guaranteed tear-proof, non-chafing or permanently colorfast?

acceptedAnswer.text: No measured test is supplied for those absolute claims. Review seam strength, abrasion, colorfastness, elastic recovery and skin-contact comfort on the selected fabric and physical sample.

mainEntity.name: What are the minimum order and sample conditions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected custom projects start at 10 pieces. Confirm minimums per style, design and colorway. The advertised 3–7 day sample target begins after artwork and details are confirmed; sourcing, patterns and revisions can change timing.
